name: Mapuzo
description: Mapuzo was a world located in the Mapuzo system in the Hollan sector, which lay in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Via a hyperlane, Mapuzo was connected to the Nicandra system in the Nicandra sector and the Walin'or system in the Shiwal sector.
lead_paragraphs: Mapuzo was a world located in the Mapuzo system in the Hollan sector, which lay in the New Territories portion of the Mid Rim. Via a hyperlane, Mapuzo was connected to the Nicandra system in the Nicandra sector and the Walin'or system in the Shiwal sector.
Mapuzo was the site of the Mapuzo break-in, which occurred sometime by 2 ABY. In 12 ABY, during the Orinda campaign by the Imperial Remnant, Mapuzo lay within the territory of the New Republic.
